notes.title: Steam Page Live
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I’m excited to share that our Steam store page is now live! It’s a big step forward for the project. [/p][p]Progress has been steady, and while development is happening in between a busy schedule. I’m fully committed to bringing this world to life. The next goal is to have a closed playable test version to help us obtain early feedback.[/p][p]In the meantime, here’s a look at the updated concept for our main hero. I am really proud of how this game is evolving and can’t wait to share more soon.[/p][p]If you like what you see, feel free to wishlist the game. It really helps![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being here,[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658928/67fd12a576464ac2912414e0373e2d588b8805c6.png"][/img][/p]
